feature: Complete supplier timber delivery into physical warehouse storage
user_outcome: Two actual workers unload one real timber bundle, shoulder-carry it together and visibly deposit it into the warehouse; the truck departs safely and another order can be placed.

existing_owners.custody: IdentityLedger.joint_carries: begin/move/finish/put_down keep one physical stock identity and two exclusive worker commitments
existing_owners.scheduling: Receiving and Freight event boundaries; no added global clock, repeating scheduler or animation stock callbacks
existing_owners.storage: WarehouseService reserves one finite existing timber cell before cargo leaves the truck
existing_owners.geometry: Existing paired_ground_path checks the complete fixed-orientation worker/load envelope; authored turns require actual clear staging space
existing_owners.art: Artist Director owns new anatomical contacts, continuous motion, verified exports and normal-speed appearance review; Lead owns integration

first_independent_increment.change: Adopt the already delivered separate warehouse long-stock v04 model and timber-only .60/1.75m cell planes; preserve original rack and crate handling.
first_independent_increment.collision: Reuse cached exact static mesh collision, so the authored openings are not filled by old coarse boxes.
first_independent_increment.startup: Include revised fixture in existing loading-cover preparation and declared remote import dependencies.
first_independent_increment.check: One brief GitHub current-change observation of the revised timber-only fixture, four cell registrations and preserved ordinary crate planes. Retrieve the actual generated import sidecar; no local engine.
first_independent_increment.not_complete: This is not a finished animated paired delivery. Do not bind historical rejected clips or remove the current honest timber hold until the shared action and accepted motion are connected.

check_result.scope: Actual revised import/bounds, four timber cells, unchanged crate cells and exact mesh collision; no paired motion

pair_action_contract: Respect the shared hauling priority selector; never borrow a busy worker, consume a higher-priority commitment, or strand one waiting worker instead of feasible lower-priority work.
Select two distinct eligible physically available hauling workers; reserve both exclusively before claiming one <=50kg source package and one warehouse cell.
No second eligible person, warehouse cell, truck aisle or complete swept route means cargo stays aboard with a specific event-woken reason.
Prepare a missing compatible fixture through a real worker visit and existing smoke lifecycle before access.

Keep fore/aft roles attached to the same worker identities. Actual pickup stations, start/stop/turn/ramp/put-down paths and grip release come from the accepted export metadata, never guessed legacy sockets.
Use one shared custody begin, atomic pair/payload motion, and one actual destination finish/warehouse commit. Both workers retain their original 25kg contribution limits.

Reassignment/return before lift releases uncollected promises safely. After lift finish the real supported deposit or existing recoverable put-down; never delete or duplicate cargo. A ground put-down does not commit a warehouse cell, count supplier return, refund cargo, or complete the physical delivery gate; it needs an actual recovery route.
Pause freezes committed progress and active cosmetics. Hidden views keep applicable domain progression and stop cosmetic frame processing.
Return/departure still waits for actual handlers, cargo and shelf/ramp/door clearance. Convoy readiness follows the existing final physical handover/departure rules.

designer_scope_review.decision: Observable plan accepted with hauling-priority and recoverable-put-down accounting clarifications incorporated above; final connected-head and animation acceptance remain separate.
designer_scope_review.source: Direct Designer response to this Lead plan in the current task on 13 November 2026

required_artist_handoff: Approved shoulder/stabilizer contact frames and continuous actual-worker video
Source/export hashes, clip windows and floor-root/payload transforms
Truck pickup/ramp and warehouse lower/upper face transitions fitted to accepted unchanged assets
No hand/torso or glove/load penetration, no excessive ramp bounce, stable fore/aft identity
verification_policy: Only brief changed-action checks on GitHub. No local Godot, regression suites, raised performance limits or broad FPS acceptance. Human appearance review is distinct from Lead/Designer PR decisions.

metrics.token_reason: Parent chat does not expose attributable provider counters; no estimate substituted.
metrics.regression_reason: No regression campaign is authorized; record only observed changed-action failures and planning omissions.

next_independent_increment.change: Adopt delivered S1v03 ONLY for timber racks, matching .60/.95m truck-floor support planes and explicit bundle base registration. Preserve metal S1 legacy geometry/packing and existing vehicle/cargo envelopes.
next_independent_increment.variant_rule: M04 and non-M04 S1 packets must not share support definitions. Timber remains left-side, exactly one bundle per deck, no timber-on-timber stacking.
next_independent_increment.transform: Use existing measured Cargo_Floor-to-rack placement once; no new recentering or truck geometry edit.
next_independent_increment.startup_and_check: Declare actual model import and existing loading-cover preparation, then one bounded exact-variant/actual-render-model current-change demonstration on GitHub. Keep rejected motion unbound.

check_result.scope: Static actual variant/import/packet support/placement only; motion remains unfinished

planning_discoveries: Actual import dependencies were duplicated; first new-asset check detected the missed second list. Replaced copies with one shared manifest.
Ordinary begin_carry currently enforces mass only; supplier pair activation must not silently allow a lighter2m bundle to become a solo downstream haul.
Recoverable ground-held timber needs a retained owner/recovery route and explicit debug/return/convoy accounting, even after hands are released.

implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.priority_selection: HaulingPolicy.start_available visits categories across the actual idle pool. Offer pair candidates only within the unloading category after higher-priority commitments; mark both actual actors before lower categories can claim either. Dedicated Receiving staff must use the same exclusive rules.
implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.custody: IdentityLedger.joint_carries already provides begin/move/finish/put_down. Receiving counts delivery only after actual joint finish AND one matching WarehouseService.commit; mass allowance remains25kg/person.
implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.warehouse: One finite token must retain both participant service points and safe access/clearance; do not add a second cell promise for the same package. Exact final stations come from accepted motion, not guessed legacy undergrip sockets.
implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.routes: PairedGroundPath currently certifies fixed-orientation translations only. It does not authorize instant heading changes at elbows; actual start/stop and authored swept turns need clear staging space from the measured new metadata.
implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.return_and_debug: SupplierReturns and debug_deliver_resources must recognize pending pair/ground custody even when personal carrying pointers are empty. No return/refund/deposit/convoy completion may be fabricated by a cleared hand.
implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.interruptions: Keep actual recoverable package ID/origins and an event-woken recovery route after put_down. Release worker eligibility separately from physical delivery/return accounting.
implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.views: One shared clip/root/payload time; explicit FORE/AFT identity; stage transform once; cosmetic-only processing while active/visible; no runtime IK or animation stock callbacks.
implementation_couplings_before_pair_cod.activation_boundary: No historical rejected hand-carry draft, pose-only image or unverified shared-library fit is a valid continuous-motion handoff.

ordinary_timber_carry_boundary_before_ed.designer_decision: Current checkpoint ends with actual paired supplier receipt, safe departure and another order; onward timber to production/staging is unfinished and not required for this checkpoint. Even lighter2m portions require two actual handlers.
ordinary_timber_carry_boundary_before_ed.implementation: Refuse unsupported solo M04 at ordinary feasible-task selection so other jobs continue; also refuse timber-to-person primitive transfers and outbound admissions needing unimplemented paired handling. JointMaterialCarry remains the only real two-person custody path; no new worker or capacity exception.
ordinary_timber_carry_boundary_before_ed.check: A brief current-change ordinary hauling/refusal observation will verify no solo reservation/assignment while another feasible material job proceeds. No broad regression campaign.
ordinary_timber_carry_boundary_before_ed.prepublication_source_amendment: Legacy receiving orders can lack packet manifests; identify timber through retained source_codes or a light actual stock identity before single-worker selection. Do not rely on packet metadata alone or let the ledger refusal reach Receiving._must. Reuse the same cached code instead of repeated deep inspection.

custody_increment_before_edits.owner: Receiving-owned SupplierTimberHandoffs, connected to JointMaterialCarry custody events and WarehouseService committed-stock event
custody_increment_before_edits.state: Pending action references actual stock IDs; no duplicate inventory. Ground put-down retains a pending supplier obligation after personal joint pointers clear. A recovery transfers the obligation to actual new stock without erasing remaining ground quantity.
custody_increment_before_edits.completion: Only a matching real warehouse cell commit counts unloaded. A finish pose, empty hand, shared-carry release or ground put-down does not.
guards: Debug resource delivery preflight refuses every selected order with a pending joint/ground handoff before mutation.
Normal completion and supplier return readiness retain physical gate until actual warehouse receipt.
custody_increment_before_edits.rationale: Godot signals notify owners at actual custody/receipt transitions; no periodic stock scans or animation callbacks.
custody_increment_before_edits.acceptance: One brief current-change normal pickup/put-down/recovery/warehouse-receipt demonstration, without damage injection, suites, animation acceptance or raised limits.
